# GRPO 知识图谱

## Overview of GRPO vs PPO
```mermaid
flowchart LR
    PPO["PPO Framework"] --> PolicyP["Policy (generates actions)"]
    PPO --> Critic["Critic (value estimator)"]
    PPO --> Ref["Reference Policy (KL anchor)"]
    PPO --> Old["Old Policy (snapshot)"]
    GRPO["GRPO Framework"] --> PolicyG["Policy (trainable)"]
    GRPO --> GroupAdv["Group Relative Advantage"]
    GRPO --> RefKL["Reference KL (optional)"]
    Critic -. removed .-> GRPO
    Ref -. optional .-> GRPO
    PolicyP -->|replaced by| PolicyG
    GroupAdv -->|replaces| Critic
    RefKL -->|adds| KLPenalty
```

## Advantage Computation Pipeline
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Prompt["Prompt Q"] --> Sample["Sample G completions"]
    Sample --> Reward["Reward per completion"]
    Reward --> Mean["Group mean reward"]
    Reward --> Std["Group std reward"]
    Reward --> Center["Centered advantage (r - mean)"]
    Center --> StdScale["Optionally divide by std"]
    StdScale --> Broadcast["Broadcast advantage to tokens"]
    Broadcast --> Ratio["Importance ratio (current/old)"]
    Ratio --> Clip["Clip ratio (PPO clipping)"]
    Clip --> Loss["Token loss = -min(clip, unclipped)"]
    Loss --> Update["Policy gradient update"]
```

## Training Loop with Log Probes
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    SampleOld["Sample with old policy"] --> CurrLog["Current log‑probabilities"]
    SampleOld --> OldLog["Old log‑probabilities (detach)"]
    CurrLog --> Ratio["Compute importance ratio"]
    OldLog --> Ratio
    Ratio --> Clip["Apply PPO clipping"]
    Clip --> Surrogate["Surrogate objective"]
    Surrogate --> KL["Add KL penalty (if β>0)"]
    KL --> LossTotal["Total loss (surrogate + KL)"]
    LossTotal --> Grad["Back‑propagation"]
    Grad --> PolicyUpdate["Update current policy"]
    PolicyUpdate --> Snapshot["Refresh old policy snapshot"]
```

## Engineering knobs & monitoring
```mermaid
flowchart LR
    GroupSize["Group size G"] --> Temp["Sampling temperature"]
    GroupSize --> Mem["Memory consumption"]
    Temp --> Throughput["Generation throughput"]
    Throughput --> RewardScale["Reward scaling (mean, std)"]
    RewardScale --> ClipThresh["Clip thresholds"]
    ClipThresh --> Beta["Beta for KL penalty"]
    Beta --> KLPenalty["KL regularization"]
    RewardScale --> Monitoring["Monitoring metrics"]
    Monitoring --> RatioLow["Low clip ratio"]
    Monitoring --> RatioHigh["High clip ratio"]
    Monitoring --> StdZero["Zero‑variance group proportion"]
    Monitoring --> TokenLen["Avg token length & truncation"]
    TokenLen --> Adjust["Adjust hyper‑parameters"]
```
